candidates.description: This vector represents biochemical, pharmacological, and neurochemical substances or their precursors.
This vector represents words related to usage, utilization, and the act of using something, predominantly in Spanish and English.
This vector represents anatomical structures, internal organs, and associated medical conditions or diseases.
These tokens represent common Spanish adjectives and adverbs used for description, qualification, and emphasis.
This vector represents adverbial or nominal suffixes and morphological derivations across Romance languages, particularly Italian, Spanish, and Portuguese.
This vector represents relative pronouns and interrogative adverbs across multiple languages, primarily functioning to introduce subordinate clauses or questions.
These tokens represent words and word fragments related to continuity, duration, and uninterrupted extent.
This vector represents numeric values and counts, specifically commonly used integers and measurements.
These tokens represent Spanish verb roots and stems associated with actions, occurrences, and relationships.
This vector activates for roots and words related to the Latin-derived morpheme meaning "to lead" or "to bring forth" (duc/duct).
